fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole small fiberglass boat (1957 Flyin Flivver hull), which we can clean and polish.
findings: Dull, faded red finish across the deck and hull sides with uneven, chalky-looking patches
Pale, washed-out and flaking area on the interior floor/corner near the chain
Torn black gasket or rubber strip hanging from the rub rail fitting on the hull side
Dirt and grime on the deck surface and around the rope handle
Light rust staining around the screw holes on the transom motor plate
message: Hi Steve, we saw your listing for the 1957 Flyin Flivver. The red finish on the deck and hull looks faded and chalky in spots, and there's some grime around the rope handle and transom plate. We do mobile gelcoat polishing and pre-sale cleanups and can come to you, which could help a rare piece like this photograph better. Would you like a quote?
